83151992.title: File:Chicken Teriyaki with rice and salad - Momotaro AUD14 (3470404176).jpg

ObjectName.value: Chicken Teriyaki with rice and salad - Momotaro AUD14 (3470404176)

Categories.value: Flickr images reviewed by FlickreviewR 2|Files from rice tag of Alpha Flickr stream uploaded by Netha Hussain

ImageDescription.value:
The authentic Japanese food is always yummy at Momotaro!

Probably one of the best tonkotsu ramen in town with their milky pork-bone soup and chewy yet smooth noodles! I keep forgetting to get the vegetables on a separate plate though, they interfere with my slurping of the noodles :)

The Curry Katsu with rice was a bit strange. The curry was packed with lentils and actually quite nice with rice, but it didn't seem to go well with the crisp breaded pork cutlet.

Phil wanted to try the Teriyaki Chicken. That was good too, with a rich, sweet sauce that wasn't too sweet, but it lacked the smokiness of the teriyaki chicken at Don Don.

I really have to learn how to fix the white-balance problems with my Nikon D60 though. I think in No Flash mode, the White Balance is set to default :(


Momotaro Rahmen 392 Bridge Rd Richmond 3121

(03) 9421 1661
